{{Quote|It is a rite acolytes have participated in for ten thousand years.|Overseer Ragate|audio=Ragate-RiteTenThousandYears-TOR.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''rite of blood and bone''' was an ancient rite practiced on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].

==Overview==
To complete the rite, an acolyte was to enter a secret room and claim a skull from a bone pile protected by [[Shyrack/Legends|shyracks]], an altar to the Academy's failed apprentices. Once the skull had been collected, the acolyte had to bathe it in a pool of blood. This would summon an arcane creature called the [[Bloodfiend]], and the initiate had to defeat the beast to prove their worth.

Throughout history, many [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords]] perpetrated the ritual. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Ragate]] was the keeper and administrator of this old rite. Both the [[Darth Nox|heir]] of [[Aloysius Kallig]] and the [[Empire's Wrath]] might have successfully taken the rite under Ragate's administration.

==Behind the scenes==
The performing of this rite constituted the minor Blood Legacy quest in the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The game's ESRB rating summary cited this ritual as a reason why the "blood and gore" content descriptor was added to its Teen rating.
